name: Microsoft Bridge-Compatible Trajectories
summary: 微软采集的 WidowX 轨迹提供七维动作/状态、多路相机流及每回合模态存在标记。
summaryEn: Microsoft-collected WidowX trajectories provide seven-dimensional actions/state, multiple camera streams and per-episode modality-presence flags.
organizations: Dataset contributors named in the official TFDS citation
organizationsZh: 官方 TFDS 引用中列出的数据贡献者
license: Dataset-specific release terms; TFDS code license does not establish data permission
licenseZh: 适用数据专属条款；TFDS 代码许可不等于数据授权
access: Official TFDS schema and RLDS storage reference; full download not tested
accessZh: 官方 TFDS 结构与 RLDS 存储入口；完整下载未测试
wmNote: 由微软按 Bridge 兼容格式采集，不是伯克利 BridgeData 下载包的改名。该发布列于 TFDS Open X 注册表，不能与聚合集合直接叠加样本量。
wmNoteEn: Collected at Microsoft in a Bridge-compatible format; this is not simply a renamed Berkeley BridgeData download. Part of the TFDS Open X registry; do not sum its samples with the aggregate.

evidence.locator: Description, feature structure, splits and citation
evidence.statement: Microsoft-collected WidowX trajectories provide seven-dimensional actions/state, multiple camera streams and per-episode modality-presence flags. Steps are organized into episodes. Collected at Microsoft in a Bridge-compatible format; this is not simply a renamed Berkeley BridgeData download.

yearBasis.description: Publisher version March 14, 2024; download page dated July 15, 2024.
